summary: IAMGOLD Corp filed a Form 6-K with an exhibit (Ex-99.1) describing a third amended and restated credit agreement dated June 17, 2026 for an $850 million credit facility. The borrowing is secured by guarantees and assets, with conditions precedent relating to effectiveness and advances. The facility's term, repayment, interest rates, fees, and covenants (including financial covenants) mirror standard debt restructuring. The filing is a credit facility refinancing/restructuring, not a routine event; it enables capital returns by freeing up liquidity. The document includes co-lead arrangers and documentation agents. Attention should be on debt servicing and potential future special returns.
